notes: Fixture names are explicit; helpers are never discovered as executable tests.
Modeled proofs do not replace native database or HTTP verification.
Minimum/current compatibility is proved by selected native scenarios, not inferred for every fixture.
Browser fixtures use maintained plugin bytes; direct fixture calls may retain workstation convenience fallbacks.
